rationale: Expand normalized scalar, count, vector, matrix and directional laws through the alea facade; add explicit support metadata and generic analytic model factors. Consolidate common distribution imports in the component prelude, preserving facade usage without compatibility aliases. Add a bounded-domain Bingham holonomic normalizer with separate conservative research classification. No stable publication or uniform numerical certification is inferred from these API additions.
